requirements.quote:
The "certificate_authorities" extension is used to indicate the
   certificate authorities (CAs) which an endpoint supports and which
   SHOULD be used by the receiving endpoint to guide certificate
   selection.
requirements.condition: a receiving endpoint selects a certificate and certificate_authorities is present
requirements.required_behavior: use the indicated supported certificate authorities to guide certificate selection
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate selection can be exercised with alternative chains under different authority lists.

requirements.quote:
The body of the "certificate_authorities" extension consists of a
   CertificateAuthoritiesExtension structure.
requirements.required_behavior: encode the extension body as a CertificateAuthoritiesExtension structure
requirements.why_checkable: The extension parser can assert the declared message structure.

requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing a DistinguishedName
requirements.required_behavior: encode it as an opaque vector between 1 and 65535 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty DistinguishedName or one longer than 65535 bytes
requirements.why_checkable: The vector length prefix exposes the declared bounds.

requirements.required_behavior: encode the DistinguishedName vector with content length between 3 and 65535 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty authorities vector or one outside the declared range
requirements.why_checkable: The authorities vector length prefix is directly inspectable.

requirements.quote:
authorities:  A list of the distinguished names [X501] of acceptable
      certificate authorities
requirements.required_behavior: populate it with distinguished names of acceptable certificate authorities
requirements.why_checkable: Decoded list entries can be compared with the configured acceptable authorities.

requirements.condition: when encoding a distinguished name in certificate_authorities
requirements.required_behavior: represent the distinguished name in DER format
requirements.why_checkable: Each DistinguishedName byte vector can be parsed and checked for DER encoding.

requirements.quote:
The "trusted_ca_keys" extension [RFC6066], which serves a similar
   purpose but is more complicated, is not used in TLS 1.3
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use the trusted_ca_keys extension for TLS 1.3 certificate-authority signaling
requirements.why_checkable: TLS 1.3 extension generation and processing paths can be inspected for trusted_ca_keys use.
